name: Email deliverability check
description: Make transactional email trustworthy: admin email sanity, test message, plugin-based SMTP detection, notification inventory.

steps.title: Identity
steps.detail: Call wp_get_settings and report the admin email and from-name expectations; fix typos with wp_update_settings on confirmation.

steps.title: Send a test
steps.detail: Call wp_test_email to the owner-provided address and report the result code.

steps.title: SMTP detection
steps.detail: Call wp_list_plugins and look for SMTP/mail plugins; if present, call wp_get_plugin_setting for the relevant keys WITHOUT echoing credentials, and report configured/not-configured.

steps.title: Notification inventory
steps.detail: List what the site sends (comment moderation, new user, Woo notifications via wc_list_email_notifications when present) so the owner knows the dependency on deliverability.

steps.title: Report
steps.detail: Deliver: test result, SMTP status, notification dependency list, and the recommended fix path (SMTP plugin + SPF/DKIM at DNS, owner-managed).

guardrails: SMTP passwords and API keys are never printed: configured/not-configured only.
One test email per run to an owner-provided address: no mass sends.
